hook_text: Fourteen transactions. Four notebooks. Can you put every one in the right place first time?
clip_script: Kasi Cycles, Soweto, November. Four questions sort everything. Money came in? CRJ. Money went out? CPJ. Sold on credit? DJ. Bought on credit? CJ. Cash sales of R9 000: CRJ. A courier company buys on credit: DJ. Stock from a supplier on credit: CJ. Wages: CPJ. Now the traps. Stock bought and paid for today: CPJ, under Trading stock. Paying a supplier for last month's stock: CPJ, under Creditors control, never Trading stock again. A school pays its account: CRJ, under Debtors control, no new sale. Add up. CRJ: R21 000 in. CPJ: R16 700 out. DJ: R7 500 of credit sales. CJ: R11 000 bought on credit. Every transaction, once.
visual_style: Four colour-coded notebooks on a counter, transaction cards flying into the right one, traps flashing red before they land correctly, totals stamped at the end.
pacing: Rapid sorting, a pause on each trap, a crisp total at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and record Kasi Cycles' November yourself.
